assets.source: https://open.canada.ca/data/en/dataset/262451e7-6416-47b5-8453-f31d212ea657 (DFO Small Craft Harbours, REST: https://egisp.dfo-mpo.gc.ca/arcgis/rest/services/open_data_donnees_ouvertes/small_craft_harbours_en/MapServer layers 0-1); Telegraph Cove, Iqaluit, Qikiqtarjuaq from the Canadian Geographical Names Database (https://geogratis.gc.ca/services/geoname/en/geonames)
assets.processing: 250 curated core/non-core fishing harbours with display names (e.g. Rivière-au-Renard, Daajing Giids), DFO region and coast assigned by province and location; 36 marked major. Approach points (open water, mostly 1-4 km off; up to ~6.5 km for inlet harbours, ~13.5 km for Pangnirtung's fjord) derived from a Natural Earth 10m water raster. Generated by scripts/generate-fleet.mjs; cached inputs and provenance in scripts/data/SOURCES.md.

assets.source: Synthetic: generated by scripts/generate-fleet.mjs (seed 20261124); land mask from Natural Earth 10m land 5.1.1 + minor islands 4.1.0 (https://naturalearth.s3.amazonaws.com/10m_physical/); area labels from data/atlantic.geojson (NAFO) and data/pacific.geojson (PFMA)
assets.license: Synthetic demonstration data (no third-party content); Natural Earth: public domain
assets.processing: 2,799 invented vessels (names, CFV numbers, licences, grounds, routes, phases) by region and fishery; offshore grounds sampled on named banks/shelf edges and kept in Canadian-fished waters; routes by A* on a conservative water raster (0.02° Atlantic, 0.01° Pacific) and string-pulled, all points and segments on water. Not CFIS or DFO records. Deterministic: re-running yields identical bytes.

assets.title: Alma Paulin Fishing Boat
assets.creator: Air Digital (AirDigitalca, Sketchfab)
assets.processing: Photogrammetry scan of a Cape Island-style inshore boat ashore in New Brunswick. scripts/blender/prepare-cape-islander.py (Blender 5.2): levelled and aligned (metres, bow +Z, Y up); grass, stands, boarding stairs, a leaning rack and a picnic table removed; hull cut 0.45 m above the ground (0.55 m below the painted waterline) and capped; vessel name painted out on both bows and the transom; 8192 px source texture reduced to 4096 px; lit material (roughness 0.85); decimated; Cycles AO baked to COLOR_0. gltf-transform 4 optimize: meshopt, WebP 4096 px. 12.95 m overall; waterline 0.55 m above the lowest point. Weathered hull: illustrative, not a specific registered vessel.

assets.title: Fishing Vessel IV
assets.creator: agt14032013 (Sketchfab); bucket by Melonpolygons, fish by yimit (credited by the author)
assets.processing: West Coast-style seiner. scripts/blender/prepare-pacific-seiner.py (Blender 5.2): coincident duplicate deck/roof slabs removed; scaled to 17.0 m overall (source not in metres); per-object planar dissolve + collapse decimation; long edges split to <=0.9 m; Cycles AO baked to COLOR_0. gltf-transform 4 optimize: meshopt, WebP <=1024 px. Frame metres, bow +Z, keel at y=0, waterline 1.01 m above the keel. Painted name "COMMANDO" is from the model, not a registered vessel.
